articles.headline: Larsen and Toubro Secures $1.57B AI Data Centre Order
articles.whyItMatters: Signals massive infrastructure spending on artificial intelligence capabilities in India.
articles.brief: Larsen and Toubro has secured a major order worth up to $1.57 billion to construct an advanced AI data centre in India.

articles.headline: Google Unveils Gemini 3.7 Flash AI Model
articles.whyItMatters: Advances coding and agent workflow automation for enterprise developers globally.
articles.brief: Google has officially introduced the Gemini 3.7 Flash AI model, specifically optimized for enhanced coding tasks and complex agent workflows.

articles.headline: State Bank of India Raises $500 Million Overseas
articles.whyItMatters: Demonstrates strong international investor confidence in Indian financial institutions.
articles.brief: The State Bank of India successfully raised $500 million through overseas bonds, drawing robust international orders totaling $2.46 billion.

articles.headline: Cerebras Slumps on Mixed Quarterly Results
articles.whyItMatters: Tests broader market confidence in the ongoing hardware-driven artificial intelligence growth narrative.
articles.brief: Cerebras shares dropped following mixed quarterly financial results, leading investors to question near-term AI hardware growth trajectories.

articles.headline: US Can Maintain Iran Naval Blockade Indefinitely
articles.whyItMatters: Escalates geopolitical tensions and secures strategic choke points in the Middle East.
articles.brief: The Pentagon chief asserted that the United States Navy can maintain its ongoing naval blockade on Iranian ports indefinitely through rotations.

articles.headline: WHO Warns Congo Ebola Outbreak May Turn Deadliest
articles.whyItMatters: Highlights urgent public health risks and the potential for a massive regional epidemic.
articles.brief: With over 4,500 infections and 2,100 deaths recorded, the WHO warns that the escalating Ebola outbreak in Congo could become history's deadliest.

articles.headline: Supreme Court Pulls Up FSSAI Over Warning Labels
articles.whyItMatters: Directly impacts consumer health transparency and food safety regulations across the country.
articles.brief: The Supreme Court sharply criticized FSSAI and central authorities over delays in implementing clear front-of-pack warning labels on food items.

articles.headline: Uttarakhand Tunnel Collapse Traps Six Workers
articles.whyItMatters: Triggers emergency rescue efforts at a critical infrastructure construction site.
articles.brief: Rescue teams are racing against time in Chamoli after an influx of water and debris left six workers trapped inside a tunnel.

articles.headline: Bar Council Reverses Nalsar Enrollment Ban
articles.whyItMatters: Resolves a major legal education controversy concerning student activism and regulatory overreach.
articles.brief: The Bar Council of India quickly reversed its blanket enrolment ban on Nalsar’s 2026 graduating batch, noting most students were innocent.

articles.headline: Air India Expands Drug Testing for All Pilots
articles.whyItMatters: Strengthens aviation safety standards following a high-profile crew drug test failure.
articles.brief: Air India has broadened mandatory drug testing protocols to cover all pilots after a captain recently tested positive for marijuana use.

articles.headline: Jharkhand CM Urges PM Modi to Reconsider Mining Bill
articles.whyItMatters: Highlights fiscal federalism disputes and state revenue protection against central legislative changes.
articles.brief: Jharkhand Chief Minister Soren wrote to Prime Minister Modi, warning that the proposed mining bill severely threatens the state's finances.

articles.headline: Parties Vie for Dalit Votes Amid BSP Decline
articles.whyItMatters: Shifts electoral dynamics significantly ahead of upcoming assembly elections in Uttar Pradesh.
articles.brief: Major political parties in Uttar Pradesh are aggressively courting Dalit voters to fill the political vacuum left by Mayawati's shrinking base.

articles.headline: Auqib Nabi Recalls Surprise India Cricket Call-Up
articles.whyItMatters: Highlights unexpected sporting breakthroughs for domestic fast bowlers entering international series.
articles.brief: Fast bowler Auqib Nabi reflected on his shock inclusion in the Indian cricket squad as a replacement for the injured Jasprit Bumrah.

articles.headline: Rithik Guides Team to Victory in TNPL Thriller
articles.whyItMatters: Showcases emerging domestic talent in high-pressure regional Twenty20 cricket tournament matches.
articles.brief: Rithik delivered a stellar performance to secure a dramatic last-ball victory for his side in the latest TNPL cricket encounter.

articles.headline: Turkey Plans Defense Pact with Pakistan and Saudi Arabia
articles.whyItMatters: Reshapes regional security alliances and military cooperation across the Middle East and Asia.
articles.brief: Turkey has officially laid out comprehensive plans for a multi-nation defense pact involving both Pakistan and Saudi Arabia.

articles.headline: Air India CEO Warns Staff Over Strict Rule Enforcement
articles.whyItMatters: Emphasizes corporate accountability and operational discipline within major airline carriers.
articles.brief: Air India CEO Campbell Wilson warned employees that consequences for protocol violations will increase significantly moving forward.
